content.text: Digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable face significant challenges in setting up online stores. This guide addresses how to utilize [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-github-pages-free-digital-product-4|The Complete]]-infrastructure-17|supabase]] as your order database, ensuring you can accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-everything-you-need-6|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments seamlessly without relying on Stripe or similar services. By leveraging COREMERCH's stacks, you can establish a fully operational digital storefront that aligns with your needs. Whether you opt for Stack 01 or Stack 02, you’ll find a solution tailored for sovereign commerce, free from the pitfalls of conventional payment processors.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal often exclude users in various regions, creating barriers for digital creators. COREMERCH's infrastructure resolves this by providing a stack that is decentralized and sovereignty-focused. Stack 01, utilizing GitHub Pages and Apps Script, allows creators to deploy their stores quickly, while Stack 02 enhances capabilities with Cloudflare Pages and Workers. This ensures that you aren't reliant on third-party platforms. Instead, you own your infrastructure, enabling you to operate freely and independently, even amid financial instability.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your digital store effectively, you need a clear understanding of the tools involved. For Stack 01, you will require a GitHub account for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic. If opting for Stack 02, ensure you have access to Cloudflare and Supabase. Familiarize yourself with NOWPayments for crypto processing, which will facilitate seamless transactions. Additionally, gather your digital products, be it ebooks, courses, or software, and prepare them for upload. This preparation is vital for a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your infrastructure ready, it's time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. For Stack 01, integrate NOWPayments into your Apps Script, ensuring that payment verification occurs automatically. Set up your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery—both are cost-effective solutions for hosting your digital products. If you're using Stack 02, leverage the power of Supabase for order storage, allowing you to manage customer data efficiently. This setup guarantees that your customers receive their purchases immediately upon payment confirmation.
You own your infrastructure; no third-party dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your store and payment pipeline, it’s crucial to conduct thorough testing before going live. Use the mainnet to process test transactions, ensuring that everything works as intended. With Stack 01, expect a deployment time of 4-6 hours, while the more robust Stack 02 can be deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, fully tested and configured. Once satisfied with the testing phase, promote your store to your audience and start processing your first transactions. This step marks the transition from setup to operational status.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is live, consider strategies for scaling your operations. For Stack 01, you can gradually increase the number of products offered as your audience grows. Stack 02 provides a more extensive framework, allowing for additional integrations and features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability. Monitor performance and customer feedback closely. This will inform your next steps, whether it’s adding new product lines or enhancing your marketing efforts to reach a wider audience.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by selecting a stack that supports your needs, like COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 allows for rapid deployment using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 offers a more comprehensive setup with Cloudflare and Supabase. Both provide a pathway to sovereignty in your commerce infrastructure.
Deploy your store in hours, not weeks.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account for hosting your store. 2. Choose Stack 01 or Stack 02 based on your needs. 3. Set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. 4. Configure NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 5. Prepare your digital products for upload. 6. Test your payment pipeline on the mainnet. 7. Promote your store to your audience once testing is complete.

To build a free digital store accepting crypto payments, utilize COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. These stacks eliminate the need for traditional payment processors, allowing you to set up your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare with integrated crypto payment solutions.

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. GitHub Pages is ideal for Stack 01 while Cloudflare Pages is used in Stack 02, providing optimal performance and reliability.
What types of digital products can I sell with COREMERCH stacks?
